blocks.text: Lucky is an American crime thriller television miniseries created by Jonathan Tropper for Apple TV. It stars Anya Taylor-Joy, Annette Bening, Timothy Olyphant, and Aunjanue Ellis-Taylor with Reese Witherspoon and Cassie Pappas among the producers. Based on Marissa Stapley's 2021 novel, the series premiered on July 15, 2026, and ran for seven episodes, concluding on August 19.
